statusCode.meaning: 0 idle;1 listening;2 working;3 waiting;4 error;5 disconnected

conditionCode.meaning: 0 unknown;1 ok;2 degraded;3 error; independent of task activity

motionAmount.meaning: 0 static, 1 full subtle rig motion; composition is Rive-owned

gestureCode.meaning: 0 no gesture, character-specific codes from cast.json

reset_rule: Changing status to disconnected or enabling reducedMotion must cancel an in-progress gesture to a truthful static pose.
motion_ownership: Rive owns interpolation, blinking and character timelines; JS validates state and sends events, never re-implements pose animation.
